0.0: Do you think purple contacts would be too much, too soon? Perhaps you're right. I'll stick with my current baby blues. Oh, what's that you have there? May I take a look?

no.0: If you don't show me the item, I can't assist you. Well, perhaps I could, but I would only be eighty percent certain of my accuracy.

1.0: This is a remnant of Mystic Energy from the clone you eliminated, manifested into physical form. I'm not sure you'd be interested in the technical explanation, so I'll just say...
1.1: Use the item! There's a small chance it will transform into an item that belonged to that boss. Almost as small as the Maple World Idol crew finally accepting me this year, but we must never give up hope.
